questions.prompt: A consumer products company is preparing to launch a new product and must choose a strategy before knowing how the market will respond. A conservative rollout through existing channels will generate a guaranteed profit of \$1,000. A standard launch with broader distribution will earn \$2,000 if demand is strong and will break even if demand is weak. An aggressive nationwide launch requires significant upfront investment; if the product takes off, profits will reach \$5,000, but if it fails, the company will incur a loss of \$2,000. The leadership team must make its decision before the market response is known. Which strategy would you recommend they choose?
